PROJECT(DEVMGR)

spec2def(devmgr.dll devmgr.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/dll
    includes)

# devmgr.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/devmgr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(devmgr_shims OBJECT api.cpp properties/advprop.cpp properties/devprblm.cpp properties/hwpage.cpp properties/hwresource.cpp properties/misc.cpp devmgmt/ClassNode.cpp devmgmt/DeviceNode.cpp devmgmt/DeviceView.cpp devmgmt/MainWindow.cpp devmgmt/Node.cpp devmgmt/ResourceNode.cpp devmgmt/ResourceTypeNode.cpp devmgmt/RootNode.cpp)
target_link_libraries(devmgr_shims PRIVATE uuid wine cpprt atl_classes libsetupapi libadvapi32 libshell32 libnewdev libuser32 libgdi32 libcomctl32 libversion libmsvcrt libkernel32 libole32 liboleaut32 libuxtheme libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(devmgr_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_target_cpp_properties(devmgr_shims WITH_EXCEPTIONS WITH_RTTI)
add_cargo_module(devmgr devmgr-cargo devmgr.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS devmgr_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
